sources.title: Data sources and dates
sources.intro: RxBridge shows only facts from official pages and files. Here is what this version holds and how fresh it is.

pack.title: This data
pack.statusDraftBody: Some facts are not confirmed on the official page yet. In the app they say "Not yet confirmed — call to confirm". Please call before you rely on them.
pack.statusReleaseBody: Every fact was checked on an official page or file.

files.title: What's inside
files.hint: Each fact is either confirmed on the official source or marked "Not yet confirmed".

names.direct: Prices from drug makers and programs

prices.title: Price dates
prices.nadacNote: What pharmacies pay wholesalers — you can't check out at this number.

unverified.title: Not confirmed yet — not shipped
unverified.hint: We looked for these but could not confirm them, so the app does not show them.

verify.title: How we verify
verify.intro: Every fact in the app has a source chip. Tap it to see where the fact came from, when we checked it and how.
verify.stale: Facts get a yellow warning when they are more than 6 months old.

methods.http-200: We opened the official web page and it loaded.
methods.browser-confirmed: A person opened the official page and read the fact there.
methods.official-data-file: The number comes from a data file the government publishes.
methods.official-pdf: We read it in a document (PDF) from the official source.
methods.official-api: We got it from the source's own data service.
methods.phone-confirmed: We called the official phone number and asked.
methods.unconfirmed: We only saw it in search results, or could not open the page. Call to confirm.

what.title: What RxBridge is
what.body: RxBridge is a free app that helps you find honest prices for your medicines and programs that may help you pay. It works in English, Spanish, Chinese and Hindi.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: No account. No tracking. Your answers stay on this phone.
privacy.detail: We don't ask for your name, Social Security number or immigration status. You can delete everything in Settings.

honesty.title: Our honesty rules
honesty.rule1: We never make up a price, phone number, address or rule. If we don't know, we say so.
honesty.rule2: Every fact shows where it came from and when we checked it.
honesty.rule3: We keep three kinds of prices apart: prices you can pay today, coupon links (we never show their amount), and wholesale prices that nobody can buy at.
honesty.rule4: We say "may" and "could" because only the program can decide.
honesty.rule5: We never give medical advice. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before you change anything.

affiliation.title: Not affiliated
affiliation.body: Not affiliated with GoodRx, SingleCare, Cost Plus Drugs, Covered California, Medi-Cal, or any drug maker — names are used only to describe where to look.
